title: Potato Salad
description: Creamy, classic American style. Adapted from Serious Eats / Kenji López-Alt.
steps: Cover potatoes with salted water. Boil until fork-tender, 15-20 minutes.
Drain. When cool enough, cut into ¾-inch cubes.
Toss warm potatoes with vinegar and ½ tsp salt.
Mix mayo and mustard. Add to potatoes with celery, onion, eggs, herbs.
notes: Dress potatoes while warm - absorbs more flavor.
source: Adapted from Serious Eats / Kenji López-Alt
